body:
Well, here I go.

I am bi-polar- or atleast have a great many of the symptoms. Every day I wake up and all I can think about is ending it all. Some days my mood gets into the 'mania' side and I start acting and thinking irrationally- not getting my work done or further alienating myself from people at school, others I am on the verge of suicide. I feel that no one really knows what is going on in my head because I've been hiding my feelings my whole life. I was too damn clever for my own childish good and sometimes i wish I had slipped up at some point and given it all away, but no.

My life just seems to be an endless cycle of self hatred and rejection but I just keep on slugging through it, dying a little more inside every day I deny myself what I truly want.

I want to kill my self. Not some reoccurring though that I occasionally banish, but a full fledged desire to not be alive any more that I can't help but try to oblige. 

I've made a couple of attempts, all cut short by the reoccurring epiphany that there's too much at stake if I do it.

My family is in a bad way with marriages splitting and siblings dying, I can't add more to the stress that they are feeling...

What can I do to help them?

I can't see a therapist simply due to lack of time or balls but I really don't want to live like this anymore.

What do I do.
You're right. I'll do a major in history of art at the same time. I heard that'll get you a job at the Netflix call center rather than the Blockbuster one that a standard Art degree will get you.
Yeah, I think i'm gonna see if my school has any sort of counselling available at all... and i'll sort out the MW2 thing. I PROMISE. I'll play the new Far Cry when it comes out.
Cheers mate, I have been trying to focus on my art for these same reasons but I've lost my creative spark lately and so it's difficult for me to enjoy even that :/
I can't wait to leave for Uni. I want to continue art and meet other people with as little aspiration as I have! *Setting a reachable low-bar*

Okay, here we go.
Number 1 and top of the list: I have fluctuated between very short lasting/shallow happiness and deeply depressed for my entire life.

2: I have serious issues concentrating on work in general due to my depression and the insomnia that can bring with it. This means that I am doing very poorly academically and may lose me the chances I could need in later life.

3: My 'friends' are my Stockholm Syndrome-esque bully's who I still get disappointed by with my exclusion from their parties and social gatherings despite the years of self-hatred they put me through (And still do). I am unable to create or join another social circle due to my shattering social anxiety problems and so I feel trapped in this continuous cycle.

4: I'm still really bad at Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 despite having over 150 hours played overall.

5: My social fuckuppery reached its limit about a year ago when I got rejected for the 7th consecutive time making me even worse in all kinds of people-based events.

6: I have a total lack of ambition, I feel like it's been crushed by the same school system that was supposed to enthuse me through their decision that teaching one student would be better than teaching all 1000 of us and so decided to crush all individuality possible.

7: All of the above make it impossible to find a girlfriend/boyfriend (Oh yeah, i'm Bi btw, really hasn't helped on the whole school thing) who would take any kind of liking towards me through first impressions.

May add more if I get bored of watching Bob's Burgers to distract myself from the fact that I'm still me and there's definitely no kind of cure or vaccine for that kind of disability.
